document.title: Blender Will Not Start: Check the Jar and Lid Interlocks
document.content: Unplug the blender before inspecting or repositioning any parts. Confirm that the jar is fully seated on the drive coupling and that its handle is aligned with the base's locking mark. Check that the lid is fitted securely; some models will not operate unless both the jar and lid interlocks are engaged. Reconnect the blender and try again. If it still does not start, stop using it and contact support rather than bypassing an interlock.

query_text: My blender will not start, even though it is plugged in. The jar is seated on the base, but pressing the power button does nothing.
